newsitem.title: USA: Premier Laser says Centauri demand strong.
newsitem.headline: Premier Laser says Centauri demand strong.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems Inc on Tuesday said it is receiving strong demand for the new Centauri Er:YAG laser system for hard-tissue dentistry following approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration earlier this month.

"We originally estimated that of the 120,000 dentists currently in practice in the United States, we would hear from one to two percent as 'early adopters' in the first 12 to 18 months," Colette Cozean, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "It is now apparent that the level of enthusiasm among dentists and patients may be much higher than that.
As of last week, Premier Laser had logged more than 1,200 expressions of interest, it said.
About 10 percent of its calls were for orders, 20 percent for training, 50 percent for specifications and 20 percent with questions and no follow-up.
Premier said it plans to ship the first eight Centauri systems this month with one to two dozen more in June. A larger ramp in shipments is likely to begin over the summer.
The company believes it can manufacture up to 400 systems before the end of our fiscal year on March 31, 1998, and it is looking at ways to boost the production schedule.
